ASTRAHEALTH AI – Project Details

Project Title: An Adaptive, Explainable and Offline-First Astronaut Health Intelligence System.

1. Project Overview

ASTRAHEALTH AI is an intelligent health monitoring platform designed to monitor astronauts' physical and mental health during long-duration space missions using Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and IoT technologies.

2. Problem Statement

Astronauts experience various health challenges during space missions, including changes in heart rate, sleep disturbances, fatigue, stress and other physiological changes. Traditional monitoring systems may not identify unusual patterns across multiple health indicators. Communication delays with Earth also make continuous medical support difficult.

3. Proposed Solution

ASTRAHEALTH AI creates a personalized health profile for each astronaut and analyses multiple health parameters together. It detects unusual health patterns, generates explainable alerts and provides health insights even without internet connectivity.

4. Main Modules

  1. Health Data Collection: Collects heart rate, ECG, oxygen levels, sleep and activity data.
  2. Personal Astronaut Health Twin: Creates an individual health baseline for every astronaut.
  3. AI Anomaly Detection: Identifies unusual health patterns using Machine Learning.
  4. Explainable Alert System: Provides understandable warnings and health insights.
  5. Mental Wellness Monitoring: Tracks sleep, stress, fatigue and mood.
  6. Offline Health Monitoring: Stores and analyses health data without internet access.
  7. Mission Health Analytics: Analyses health trends alongside exercise, workload and mission conditions.

6. Working Process

  1. Collect astronaut health data using wearable sensors.
  2. Store and validate the collected information.
  3. Create a personalized astronaut health profile.
  4. Analyse health parameters using AI and ML algorithms.
  5. Detect unusual health patterns.
  6. Generate explainable health alerts.
  7. Display health reports through a dashboard.
  8. Synchronize data with Earth when communication is available.

7. Key Innovations

  • Personalized Astronaut Health Twin.
  • Multi-parameter AI health analysis.
  • Explainable and confidence-aware alerts.
  • Offline-first health monitoring.
  • Physical and mental wellness tracking.
  • Sensor reliability and missing-data detection.

8. Expected Outcomes

  • Early identification of unusual health patterns.
  • Improved astronaut health awareness.
  • Continuous physical and mental wellness monitoring.
  • Reliable health monitoring without internet.
  • Better medical decision support for space missions.

9. Future Scope

  • Integration with advanced wearable medical devices.
  • Advanced AI-based health prediction.
  • Integration with spacecraft monitoring systems.
  • Improved astronaut digital-twin technology.
  • Real-time health data sharing with mission control when communication permits.

10. Project Objective

To develop an intelligent, personalized and offline-capable astronaut health monitoring system that uses AI, ML and IoT to detect unusual health patterns and support astronaut safety during long-duration space missions.

Project Tagline: From Monitoring Astronaut Health to Understanding, Anticipating and Supporting It.
